hostname.description: System hostname to display in Monitorix web UI (leave blank to auto-detect)

base_url.description: URL path prefix for Monitorix web interface

lang.description: Default language for the web interface (e.g., en, de, fr)

cgi_buffer.description: Enable output buffering for CGI responses (recommended)

time_zone.description: System time zone for graph timestamps (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York')

ipv6_enabled.description: Listen on IPv6 addresses in addition to IPv4

lock_file.description: Path to the main Monitorix lockfile

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 = quiet, 1 = normal, 2 = verbose, 3 = debug

port.description: Port for Monitorix's built-in HTTP server

host.description: Host to bind to (empty = all interfaces). Use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to localhost

server_exe.description: Path to Monitorix's CGI script for internal server mode

pid_file.description: Path to PID file for the built-in server

cgi_path.description: URL path to the Monitorix CGI script (for external server setups)

run_as_user.description: Non-root system user to run Monitorix as (security best practice)

tmp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files (must be writable by run_as_user)

bg_color.description: Graph background color in hex format

fg_color.description: Graph foreground/text color in hex format

border_color.description: Graph border color in hex format

default_time_range.description: Default time window (seconds) for graph display (e.g., 86400 = 24 hours)

rrd_base_dir.description: Directory where RRD files are stored

rrd_step.description: RRD data collection interval in seconds (min recommended: 30)

rrd_heartbeat.description: RRD heartbeat (seconds before data considered unknown)

enabled_system.description: Enable system-level monitoring (processes, mounts, filesystems, etc.)

options.description: Monitorix command line options (e.g., -v for verbose start)
